_note: Two TikTok accounts, two films a day each (owner 2026-11-01: «4 ролика, по 2 на аккаунт»). The owner: the focus is the same for both («Для тебя пока ничем») — names come later. key = the short id in the project names (projects/news-viral-<key>-<dd-mm>-<n>) and in the bot's /tt command; name = what the delivery caption says; card_tag = the hook card's brand, {place} = РОССИЯ / the country / the city; topics / avoid_topics / regions empty = all (viral.TOPICS; regions: russia, world, regional).

_slots_note: The day's four films, made one after another (one heavy job at a time on the server): slots 1 and 3 are the day's first account's films, 2 and 4 the second's, and who goes first alternates by day. start / deadline = the timer news-viral-<slot> and morning.py --deadline (MSK); post_at = when the owner posts it, by `viral.py windows` (14 days of the federal channels, 2026-11-01: posts of 07–08 and 21–02 MSK collect 4–11 % over their channel's median, 09–17 2–4 % under).
